blocks.text: Surveys namoona group se pehle se tay sawal pooch kar munazzam tareeqe se bohat sa data jama karte hain, online forms, telephone calls ya aamne saamne interviews se. Islamabad ka ek chhota grocery store weekend par 50 gahakon se paanch sawal poochta hai: kaunsi qismein sab se zyada khareedte hain, kaunsi cheezein zyada dekhna chahte hain, kitni baar yahan aate hain, khareedari par sab se zyada kya asar dalta hai (qeemat, maeyar ya dastiyabi), aur koi aur raye. Jawab gahakon ki pasand ka saaman rakhne mein madad dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Surveys ka ek faida aur ek had bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Faida: jaldi bohat se jawab, qabil-e-muwazna shakal mein. Had: log be-parwahi ya ghair diyanatdari se jawab de sakte hain, aur sirf jawab dene wale gine jate hain. Had aam ilm hai.

items: Surveys: namoone se muqarrar sawal (online, phone, aamne saamne); maslan 50 grocery gahak.
